jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Build the low-latency, high-TPS distributed systems that decide which sponsored brand experiences billions of Amazon shoppers see. The SPB Ad Supply, Rendering, and Logging team delivers billions of ad impressions and millions of clicks daily. You'll design and develop highly scalable services that use Large Language Models (LLMs) to launch personalized ad experiences for shoppers and millions of advertisers around the world. Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) is working to make Amazon the best destination for shoppers to discover, engage with, and build affinity with brands. It helps brands of all sizes reach shoppers in the research and consideration phases through inspiring, relevant sponsored shopping experiences. Our team is behind several cross-org architectural and business initiatives with high impact and visibility. You'll work with engineering and business teams across the organization and with Senior and Principal Engineers, using the latest technologies across search, advertising, and e-commerce. Key job responsibilities - Design and develop highly scalable ad supply, rendering, and logging services that process millions of requests per day under strict latency requirements - Solve complex distributed systems problems using state-of-the-art technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs) - Deliver personalized ad experiences end to end, from design and implementation through launch and operations - Partner with engineering and business teams across the organization to design, implement, and launch features at scale - Contribute to high-visibility, cross-org architectural and business initiatives, working alongside Senior and Principal Engineers - Keep high-TPS production systems reliable and performant for both shoppers and advertisers internationally - Mentor peers through design and code reviews About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through advanced generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent - Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques - Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
jobs.description: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. We're building Chorus, a real-time document workspace where AI agents are actual collaborators: an agent gets a cursor in the doc, edits the same CRDT, and shows up in presence right next to you. We wrote it from scratch in Rust and TypeScript; we sync in under 50ms with hundreds of simultaneous editors on a single document, and it costs roughly a dollar per builder per year to run. It's an exciting combination of greenfield work with a massive user base that provides immediate feedback when something doesn't work. Requirements • You proactively seek out problems, propose solutions, and own delivery • You find ways to deliver code with agents at high speed without sacrificing the quality of the code or the software. • Experience in building distributed and high-concurrency systems We're a small team with an unusually direct line from idea to thousands of builders using it. If you want to be one of maybe a dozen people in the world shipping production CRDT infrastructure that treats AI as a peer, this is the job. Key job responsibilities • Own the design and delivery of significant components of a service scaling from early customers to broad AWS adoption • Contribute to technical discussions with partner teams — bring data, document tradeoffs, and help the team land on a decision • Recognize when a one-off solution is the right call versus when a pattern is emerging that deserves a real abstraction, and raise it with the team • Raise the bar through thorough code reviews and by helping onboard newer engineers to the codebase and team practices • Contribute to operational excellence: add monitoring and alarming for the features you build, follow through on production readiness, and take ownership during on-call A day in the life Your mornings are usually free for focus work -- architecture deep dives and hard problems. Around 11 you'll have standup, then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for design reviews, CR feedback, or unblocking an engineer. Some days you're deep in code; others you're on a call with a customer team working through how their system integrates with yours. You're the person who knows the system most deeply -- and you work to ensure you're never the bottleneck. The problems are hard and the stakes are high -- but we believe we can move fast, do exceptional work, and have a full life outside of it. About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, WA, Seattle - 143,700.00 - 194,400.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: The Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Software Development Engineer to help advance the quality and capabilities of industry-leading large language models and Generative AI systems. In this role, you will build scalable solutions for discovering, processing, curating, transforming, and delivering high-value data used across model evaluation, training, and post-training workflows. You will work with large-scale and heterogeneous datasets, including data produced by partner teams, long-context data, and other data sources that can help improve model development. You will collaborate closely with scientists, ML engineers, evaluation teams, and other engineering teams to identify valuable data sources, understand downstream data requirements, and develop mechanisms that make data easier to discover, standardize, validate, transform, and consume at scale. Your work will help expand the breadth, quality, and usability of data available for Generative AI development and establish scalable data infrastructure, quality standards, and workflows that enable downstream teams to evaluate and improve models more effectively. jobs.description: In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Principal Software Engineering position at the Vice President level, which is part of the job family responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions that support business needs. Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals. Interested in joining a team that’s eager to create, innovate and make an impact on the world? Read on. We're seeking someone to join our Equity Derivatives Technology team as an Equity Derivatives Pricing Platform Engineer in ESTAR to build and evolve a global platform supporting equity derivatives pricing, trading workflows, and front-office users. What you’ll do in the role: Build and deliver. Design, implement, test, and release platform features and fixes. Contribute hands-on while helping raise engineering standards across the team. Partner with the desks. Work directly with Sales and Trading to understand workflows, investigate issues, clarify requirements, and translate business needs into prioritized engineering work. Collaborate with quantitative model owners. Partner with Strats on product and model integration, investigate unexpected pricing results, and establish clear ownership between platform and model-related issues. Support quote, RFQ, and booking workflows. Maintain and improve integrations across pricing, quoting, RFQ, product creation, booking, and downstream systems. Work with operations and technology teams to improve reliability and supportability. Strengthen testing and verification. Establish regression testing for pricing and numerical results using reference values agreed with Strats. Expand automated testing across backend services, integrations, and user workflows. Improve engineering quality. Introduce practical quality controls such as formatting, linting, typing, automated tests, changed-code coverage, and domain-aware code review. Apply these controls incrementally so that they improve reliability without slowing delivery unnecessarily. Own production health during New York hours. Monitor the platform, investigate production issues, support deployment and rollback, and troubleshoot problems across services, data, configuration, integrations, and pricing components. Automate operational work. Identify recurring support activities and manual checks, then replace them with reliable diagnostics, monitoring, or automation where appropriate. Support platform adoption. Work with the desks and Strats to move suitable products and workflows from spreadsheet-based tools to the shared platform. Help validate that pricing outcomes are consistent or that differences are understood. Work across regions. Coordinate effectively with engineers and stakeholders in London and Asia through clear written requirements, technical decisions, documentation, and handoffs. Apply modern engineering tools responsibly. Use automation and AI-assisted development where they improve code comprehension, testing, debugging, or documentation, while maintaining appropriate review, verification, and production discipline. What you’ll bring to the role: Senior, hands-on software-engineering experience building and operating production applications, ideally in financial services or another production-critical environment. Strong backend development skills in Python, Java, or a comparable language, with the ability to learn and contribute to the platform's existing technology stack. Experience delivering reliable software across the development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and production support. Working knowledge of equity derivatives or structured products, with the ability to understand trading and pricing workflows and collaborate effectively with quantitative model owners. A record of working directly with business, product, trading, sales, or quantitative stakeholders to clarify needs and deliver practical solutions. Sound testing and troubleshooting judgment, particularly for systems involving numerical results, complex data, integrations, or external dependencies. Experience diagnosing production issues across applications, services, data, configuration, and infrastructure. Practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools, or a strong interest in applying them responsibly to complex enterprise software. Ability to work independently on ambiguous problems, establish ownership, make pragmatic decisions, and drive issues to closure. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across business functions, engineering disciplines, regions, and time zones. jobs.description: Amazon Leo is Amazon’s Low Earth Orbit satellite network, with a mission to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. Our systems span the full Leo service—from satellites and customer terminals to ground gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial network infrastructure—and enable engineers to understand network behavior, rapidly detect failures, and diagnose complex issues across space and ground infrastructure. We are looking for a talented Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate network observability and analytics solutions for an advanced global telecommunications service spanning both space and terrestrial networks. As a software engineer on this team, you will build high-scale systems that transform telemetry, network events, traces, and operational signals into actionable visibility. Where is a failure occurring? What is its customer impact? And how quickly can we identify and resolve it?
